product_metadata.title: Signature Pinch Pleated Pintuck Duvet Cover 3 Piece Set with Button Closure. Luxuriously Soft 100% Brushed Microfiber with Textured Pintuck Pleats and Corner Ties (Full/Queen, Stone Grey)
features: TOP QUALITY 3 PIECE DUVET COVER SET: Contains 1 Duvet and 2 Shams. Features a beautiful and unique pintuck pinch pleat pattern great for year round use.
FEATURES: Includes secure button closure and inside corner ties to keep duvet insert securely in place.
SIZE: Full/ Queen Set Includes a 90”x90” duvet and 2 standard 20”x26” shams. Choose from Seven COLORS: White, Ether Blue, Stone Grey, Taupe, Frosty Green, Rose Smoke, Steel Grey and Pale Green.
EASY CARE AND EASY WASH: Machine washable. Durable, high-quality material designed to last.
